scope: Selected authentic still images from saved Shopify templates and pre-redesign homepage Git history. All original bytes are preserved. Live theme changes are separate.
notes: The original homepage used quotes-named sections for image galleries; those are not automatically testimonials.
Placeholder gallery authors do not establish artist attribution. Only exact portfolio author blocks establish the names in this manifest.
Historical pricing flyers, old roulette rules, former-staff portraits, and inferior duplicates were not selected for direct preview reuse.
Some portfolio originals are small. Archive recovery does not imply that they should replace larger current images.
No generated images, recoloring, retouching, or upscale operations were used.
Duplicate or lower-quality copies of current work were excluded: candidate88 (Rigo script), candidate108 (Megan tooth gems), candidate111 (Sonny ear); candidate116 duplicates candidate115.
